name: history_artscience_taped_sharpie
description: HISTORICAL record of the first setup (2026-09-15): a capped Sharpie taped along the gripper jaws, pointing down, square sheet ~170 mm in front of the base. The mount no longer exists; kept so the ArtScience attempt can be reproduced and compared.

surface.source: servo-lag probe, 4 of 5 points (plane fit, residuals +-0.8 mm)

notes: wrist_flex sits at its +97.5 deg soft limit in this posture, so the pen attitude is set by shoulder+elbow and IK often fell onto a different elbow branch.
The model's paper plane tilts ~10 mm over 70 mm of reach (sag grows with reach).
